desc: vong tien hoa: loi lap (>=3 lan/7 ngay) -> de xuat -> oracle eval -> apply --approve co version -> rollback
cmds: scan --kind deprecate [--days N] [--cost] [--by-project] [--detail kind:id] (nguon->hanh dong, insufficient_window, duplicates_dropped; xem observe/ledger/README.md)

dupes-content [--json] [--propose] [--threshold 0.6] [--limit N] [--timeout-s N] [--raw] (khoi trung noi dung CLAUDE/AGENTS/agents/memory/knowledge; --propose toi da 3 de xuat kind fix theo chi so, khong sua file)

propose-metric --kpi kpi-routing.<khoa>|kpi-agy.<khoa> --better up|down [--target AGENTS.md] [--note <text>] (khi doi luat dinh tuyen: tao de xuat kind fix kem baseline tu series, khong sua file; retro do hieu qua)

retro [--apply] [--current] [--timeout-s N] (mac dinh tuan vua xong; KPI + chuoi tuan + selfdev + hieu qua + top-3 van de; --apply tao task; tu chay 1 lan/tuan qua ledger job, tat: config evolve retro.autoApply=false)
